CITY OF LA VERNE
  PLANNING COMMISSION
  MINUTES OF THE SPECIAL MEETING
  Wednesday, October 27, 2021

1.  Chairperson Simison called the regular meeting of the La Verne Planning
  Commission to order at 6:30 p.m.

2.  OATH OF OFFICE

  Assistant City Clerk Lupe Estrella administered the oath of office to Jeremy
  Conrad.

3.  PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Commissioner Conrad led the Pledge of Allegiance.

4.  ROLL CALL: Planning Commissioners present: Thomas Allison, Jason Lorge,
  Jeremy Conrad, and Jason Simison. Absent: Jeff Allred. Advisory personnel
  present: Community Development Director Eric Scherer, City Attorney Bob
  Kress, Contract Planner Vanessa Norwood, Assistant Planner Parker Stringfellow
  and Secretary Natalie Hiatt.

5.  PUBLIC COMMENT

  None

PUBLIC HEARINGS

6.  CASE NOS. 02-21PPR, 03-21VAR, AND 04-21PM – 1510, 1520 & 1530
  WHITE AVENUE – A PROPOSAL TO MERGE THREE PARCELS AND
  PERMIT AN INCREASED BUILDING HEIGHT FOR THE
  CONSTRUCTION OF A PROPOSED WAREHOUSE BUILDING.

  RESOLUTION NO. 1280

  A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE, COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES, STATE OF CALIFORNIA
  GRANTING A HEIGHT VARIANCE FOR A WAREHOUSE BUILDING,
  PROPOSED TO BE LOCATED ON A 3.95 ACRE PARCEL AT 1510, 1520
  AND 1530 WHITE AVENUE (APNs 8378-016-015, 8378-016-018, 8378-016-
  019) (CASE NO. 03-21VAR)
 Planning Commission Minutes
October 27, 2021
  Contract Planner Vanessa Norwood presented her staff report.

  Mr. Scherer stated that Ms. Norwood’s last day is November 3rd, after 7 months
  working with the City.

  Chairperson Simison opened the public hearing. There were no comments.

  Chairperson Simison closed public hearing.

  The Commissioners asked questions regarding the monopole negotiations and
  location options.

  Mr. Scherer stated that two options were given for the monopole location and
  neither option effect the variance for the building height.

  Commissioner Allison asked if there were any concerns from the adjacent
  neighbors.

  Ms. Norwood and Mr. Scherer stated that all adjacent neighbors were notified and
  no objections were received.

  It was moved by Commissioner Conrad and seconded by Commissioner Allison
  to approve Case No. 03-21VAR. Motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

7.  CASE NO. 79-21PPR – 900 BONITA AVENUE- REQUEST TO
  CONSTRUCT AN ADDITIONAL DWELLING UNIT.

  RESOLUTION NO. 1279

  A RESOLUTION OF THE PLANNING COMMISSION OF THE CITY OF
  LA VERNE, COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES, STATE OF CALIFORNIA,
  APPROVING CASE NO 79-21PPR, FOR A RESIDENTIAL DWELLING
  UNIT AT 900 BONITA AVENUE.

  Mr. Scherer introduced Assistant Planner Parker Stringfellow. Mr. Stringfellow
  has been with the department for four months.

  Mr. Stringfellow presented his staff report.

  Chairperson Simison opened public hearing.

  The property owners Roger and Rufina Follis and architect Hudson Pruitt were
  present. Mr. Follis stated his intentions to protect the property.

  Chairperson Simison closed the public hearing.

  2
 Planning Commission Minutes
October 27, 2021
  The Commissioners had questions regarding the historical preservation of the
  citrus trees.

  Mr. Stringfellow stated that the trees will be replaced. Mr. Scherer stated that the
  original specific plan identified the grove for historical significance.

  It was moved by Commissioner Lorge and seconded by Commissioner Conrad to
  approve Case No. 79-21PPR. Motion carried by a 4-0 vote.

ADJOURNMENT

  The meeting was adjourned at 7:03p.m. The next regular meeting of the Planning
  Commission will be held November 10, 2021 at 6:30 p.m. in the Council
  Chambers, 3660 “D” Street, La Verne, CA 91750.

  ____________________________________________
  Chairperson, Planning Commission

  ATTEST:

  _________________________________
  Secretary, Planning Commission
